temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say it has been tough, that she keeps thinking something more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara already knows Shirley cared for the patient and suspects Shirley is affected by the loss, but she is not yet certain how deep Shirley's grief or self-doubt is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's suspicion is confirmed. Shirley is deeply affected, grieving, and struggling to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death and has some self-questioning or uncertainty about whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort and reassure Shirley, and to help her process the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible and wonders if a different treatment approach might have helped. Shirley appreciates Sara's reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: From the funeral conversation, Sara suspects Shirley may feel some responsibility or uncertainty about the patient's death, but she has not heard Shirley state it directly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley carries explicit guilt and a sense of responsibility about the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels responsible for the patient's outcome and is burdened by guilt, despite Sara's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, and a wish to relieve Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue reassuring Shirley, share the burden, and help her accept that the treatment decisions were made with the information available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes that Shirley remains reserved and minimally expressive. When confronted, Shirley admits she is afraid of seeming unprofessional or weak if she opens up, though she says she will try.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the coffee-break conversation, Sara believes Shirley feels guilty and burdened, and may be hiding or suppressing her emotions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley's reserve comes from fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley is willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley struggles to express emotion because she fears being seen as unprofessional or weak, but she may be open to trying with support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her feelings, reassure her that emotion is not weakness, and provide a safe space for her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says continuing to talk helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the confrontation, Sara believes she may have pushed Shirley too hard and worries that she may have hurt or overwhelmed her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley was somewhat overwhelmed by the confrontation but is not alienated, accepts the apology, and values continued talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley understands Sara's good intentions, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking; the friendship remains supportive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief, regret for coming on too strong, and warmth or gratitude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To mend the relationship, be more sensitive, and remain available to support Shirley through continued conversation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley seems improved. Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support. Shirley accepts Sara's suggestion to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the apology and continued talks, Sara believes Shirley values their conversations and support, but may still be recovering and in need of companionship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's observation is confirmed. Shirley's demeanor has improved, she credits their talks and support, and she is receptive to spending time outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better, their talks and Sara's support have helped, and Shirley is open to deepening their friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and make plans to spend time together outside work, likely to strengthen their friendship.
